title: Matryoshka Depth
description:
## Task

A box can hold plain numbers and smaller boxes, and those boxes can hold more boxes. Here a box is written as a pair of square brackets, and the numbers inside are left out, so a whole arrangement is a string of `[` and `]`. Report how deeply the boxes are nested: the outer box alone has depth 1, a box inside it makes depth 2, and so on.

## Input

- `boxes` — a non-empty string of `[` and `]` that is correctly balanced and made of a single outer box.

## Output

The depth of the deepest box, as an integer.

## Example

```python
matryoshka_depth('[]')  # returns 1
matryoshka_depth('[[[]]]')  # returns 3
matryoshka_depth('[[][[]]]')  # returns 3
```

## Constraints

- 2 ≤ length of `boxes` ≤ 10^4
- Nesting depth ≤ 100
